outcome.Summary: Added api/handler.go with NewHandler(s *Store) http.Handler using net/http/httptest-free stdlib routing (Go 1.24 ServeMux patterns): GET /healthz (200 text/plain "ok"), POST /notes (validates non-empty trimmed title → 400 JSON error, else 201 with created note JSON), GET /notes (id-ascending list, `[]` when empty, case-insensitive ?q= filter on title/body), GET/DELETE /notes/{id} (404 missing, 400 non-integer id, 204 on delete), and 405 JSON errors for other methods on those paths. Wrote api/handler_test.go covering all endpoints with httptest. Verified `go vet ./... && go test ./...` exits 0.
